description:
FILED s521 (Fable, 2026-10-18 19:0x) from the #3494 umbrella CENSUS (docs/ioc-row-census-s521.md, a read-only Opus agent; Fable re-probed the reproducer on main 81afe6b0 vs perl 5.40.3 before filing).

REPRODUCER (core module, no dist needed; scratchpad rv/newd.pl):
    use IO::Compress::Base::Common qw(isaFilename); my ($lo, $hi) = (44, 0); print $hi * U64::MAX32 + $lo, "\n";
perl 5.40.3: `44`.   PCL main 81afe6b0: `0`.  With `use IO::Compress::Base::Common ();` or with no import list PCL emits `(p-+ (p-* ... (U64::pl-MAX32)) ...)` and prints 44.

MECHANISM (read by the census): IO::Compress::Base::Common defines `package U64` with `use constant MAX32 / HI_1 / LOW / HIGH`; `Pl/Parser.pm` `_merge_module_prototypes`' import-list branch RETURNS after importing the listed names, so the compiler has NO prototype for `U64::MAX32` (the emitted detector table lists `("U64" "MAX32" 421 "unknown")`) and the bare-name fallback that the no-list path uses never runs -- `$hi * U64::MAX32 + $lo` becomes `$hi * U64::MAX32(+$lo)`.  A hand-written module with the same layout (a second package's constant, an Exporter list, an import list) did NOT reproduce in the census, so the exact trigger inside Common.pm is still to be ISOLATED -- start from the core-module reproducer and bisect Common.pm in a scratch copy (its `use constant` list shapes, the `package U64;` position, the Exporter tags).

WHERE IT BITES: IO::Uncompress::Unzip::skipCentralDirectory64Rec computes size 0 for every Zip64 record, skips 0 bytes, reads garbage as the next signature, and `unzip` returns undef with an EMPTY $UnzipError -- 105oneshot-zip-only.t: the 11 Zip64 rows; any Zip64 archive read under PCL is silently wrong.  (The written zip64 bytes are identical to perl's -- the fault is read-side only.)

FIX SHAPE (Pl, rule 11): the import-list branch of `_merge_module_prototypes` must register the module's OTHER packages' `()`-prototype constants the same way the no-list path does (one registration path, keyed by QUALIFIED name per #421's rule; #3143's family).  Probe BEFORE / AFTER vs perl: the reproducer; the same with `qw(:Status)` (Unzip's spelling); a hand module once the trigger is isolated; `Other::CONST + 1` for a constant in the module's MAIN package under an import list (must stay right).  ACCEPTANCE: the reproducer = perl; IO-Compress 105oneshot-zip-only.t one-file run: the 11 rows pass and leave the blessed file by edit; a guard row (`Pl/t/imported-term-01.t` holds #365's; add beside), inverse FAILS on main; an EMISSION change: corpus-diff + emission-ab explained, gen bump, the sweep.


=== DONE (s521e, 2026-10-19, commit 03dcb2fc) ===
TRIGGER ISOLATED: not the module's layout at all -- its NAME.  `_extract_module_prototypes` skips every `IO::` module by name (cost), so IO::Compress::Base::Common's facts come ONLY from its facts overlay lib/PCL/Facts/IO/Compress/Base/Common.pm (#3205), which stated the main package's constants and nothing else.  The no-list `use` imported the bare MAX32 into the flat table and `U64::MAX32` fell back to it (right by accident); under an import list nothing reached it.  A hand module of the same layout under a non-skipped name walks its source and is right -- which is why the census could not reproduce it (scratch/s521e/pr/lib/HMC.pm = the full Common.pm renamed: correct).  Minimal: the core module + an import list (no hand module reproduces without an IO:: name and an overlay).
FIX (the overlay mechanism, generic): an overlay's FIRST package statement must be the module's own; a later blockless `package OTHER;` names another package the module's file declares, and the declarations after it are recorded under it (validate_facts_overlay / _facts_overlay_stmt_ok); register_unit_overlay registers only the facts the overlay states for the unit's own package.  DATA: the overlay gains `package U64; sub MAX32 (); sub HI_1 (); sub LOW (); sub HIGH ();`, the module's @EXPORT and %EXPORT_TAGS (Status) -- `qw(:Status)` expanded to NOTHING before, so `print STATUS_OK + 7` printed to a filehandle named STATUS_OK (found by the brief's :Status probe) -- and `sub WANT_* ();`.  docs/shipped-modules.md "What it may contain" updated.  gen v2-7684, three artifacts regenerated.
PROBES (scratch/s521e/pr/z1.pl) = perl 5.40.3: the reproducer 44; U64::MAX32() + 1; IO::Compress::Base::Common::MAX32 + 1; U64::HI_1 - 1; `qw(:Status)` STATUS_OK + 7; Zip64 => 1 zip + unzip round trip ok (base: unzip dies).
BAR: guards Pl/t/imported-term-01.t rows 26-27 (inverse on base-aff112d7: `0` with no newline / nothing printed); IO-Compress 105oneshot-zip-only.t one-file run 231 pass / 0 fail -- the 11 Zip64 rows LEFT the blessed file by edit.  corpus-diff / emission-ab / sweep: see the s521e session-log section.
subject: SILENT WRONG: a module's SECOND-package `use constant` loses its empty prototype when the module is `use`d WITH an import list -- `use IO::Compress::Base::Common qw(isaFilename); print $hi * U64::MAX32 + $lo` prints 0 (perl 44): `U64::MAX32 + $lo` compiles as the CALL `(U64::pl-MAX32 $lo)`; with `()` or no list it is right.  Every Zip64 unzip under PCL returns undef with an empty $UnzipError (IO-Compress 105oneshot-zip-only 11 rows); the #421 / #3143 family; layer Pl
